g.text: Checkout breaches both latency and error-rate objectives.
Alert grouping opens one incident instead of two noisy pages.
Triage compares failure signatures with recent production changes.
A read-only probe confirms the new dependency path is unhealthy.
Every observation lands in a shared, timestamped timeline.
The agent proposes a bounded rollback with supporting evidence.
High-impact production changes still require an accountable human.
The gate records policy checks and explicit approval.
Rollback starts with a small canary instead of shifting everything.
The prior release receives a controlled slice of production traffic.
Canary telemetry returns to the healthy baseline.
Passing health checks allow the rollback to finish progressively.
The final timeline preserves decisions, evidence, and recovery milestones.
The on-call closes the incident with a concrete follow-up owner.
